### Gaining What I Cannot Lose
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-december-22-2021.html
Passage: Luke 6:48
Points:
- A sinking deck footing illustrates how inadequate foundations lead to shifting and inevitable collapse.
- Floods and painful trials in life will come, but obeying Jesus' teachings keeps believers anchored.
- People frequently build their security on fleeting things such as relationships, careers, or status.
- Believers must regularly inspect their lives and anchor themselves to Christ, who can never be lost.

### Is Your Prayer Life Built on the Rock?
Author: Clarence L. Haynes Jr.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/is-your-prayer-life-built-on-the-rock-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 7:24-25
Points:
- Faith is truly tested by whether we practice God's Word when circumstances fall apart.
- Wisdom means closing the gap between knowing scripture and actively obeying it.
- Many believers undermine their prayer lives by bringing requests to God yet holding onto anxiety.
- Building on the rock means learning what Jesus said and releasing our worries to Him completely.
